card.title: Build a Coalition
card.instruction: Recruit someone to your side so your position appears broader and more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sit with me for the allotment shed vote. It shouldn't look like just my project.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only support it if everyone gets a key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Shared keys. Agreed. Will you join me now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The new plot holders need to hear that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring them over. We can present it together as the shared-access proposal.

mechanism: A recruits visible allotment support and accepts shared access so the shed proposal appears collective.
confusable: Unlike simply winning one vote, A must make the position visibly broader and more legitimate.
comparison: D55-a offers shared keys and group presentation; D55-b combines class schedules into a wider access coalition.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
